description: VR mod for Rolling Quest (itch.io): play it in a SteamVR headset, behind the ball or as a tabletop diorama.
notes: Rolling Quest VR is installed into your Rolling Quest folder (found automatically, or picked by you).
Next: run 'Rolling Quest VR - Add to Steam' from the Start menu. It adds 'Rolling Quest VR' to your Steam and SteamVR libraries
with artwork plus a desktop shortcut (Steam closes and restarts). The first start of the game takes a minute or two.
Game moved? Set the ROLLINGQUEST_DIR environment variable to its folder and install again.

script: # 1. Find the game: ROLLINGQUEST_DIR, the folder used last time, a search of the usual places, or ask.
$pick = (New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).BrowseForFolder(0, 'Rolling Quest VR: select your Rolling Quest folder (the one with RollingQuest.exe)', 0x51, 17)
if (-not $gd) { throw 'Rolling Quest not found. Set the ROLLINGQUEST_DIR environment variable to the folder with RollingQuest.exe and install again.' }
if (Get-Process RollingQuest -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close Rolling Quest first, then install again.' }
# 2. Copy the mod (BepInEx + plugin) into the game folder.
robocopy $dir $gd /E /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP /XF manifest.json install.json 'Add to Steam.bat' | Out-Null
# 3. Start menu helper: adds the Steam / SteamVR entry with artwork.
Set-Content "$dir\Add to Steam.bat" -Encoding ASCII -Value @('@echo off', "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ""$gd\BepInEx\plugins\RollingQuestVR\add-to-steam.ps1""", 'pause')
# On update the new version simply installs over the old one; only a real uninstall removes the mod.
if (Get-Process RollingQuest -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close Rolling Quest first, then uninstall again.' }
foreach ($f in 'Rolling Quest VR - Add to Steam.bat', 'Rolling Quest VR - Uninstall.bat', 'Rolling Quest VR - README.txt') { Remove-Item "$gd\$f" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# The mod loader goes too, unless other BepInEx mods still use it.
} else { Write-Host 'Other BepInEx mods found: BepInEx was left in place.' }
Write-Host "Removed Rolling Quest VR from $gd. Remove its entry from Steam by hand: right-click it > Manage > Remove non-Steam game."

shortcuts: Rolling Quest VR - Add to Steam
